desc:
Bring character and craftsmanship into your living space with this beautifully handcrafted wooden coffee table. Designed with a rustic charm and artistic detailing, this piece becomes an instant focal point in any room.

The tabletop features a striking grid-style design with inset brass panels, each hand-embossed to create rich texture and visual depth. The natural wood frame enhances the warmth of the piece, while subtle metal corner accents add a vintage-inspired touch. The sturdy turned legs provide both stability and timeless appeal.

Spacious and functional, this table is perfect for serving drinks, displaying décor, or gathering around with family and friends. Its balanced proportions make it ideal for living rooms, lounges, or even as a statement piece in a cozy seating area.

Blending traditional craftsmanship with practical design, this table fits beautifully into rustic, vintage, or eclectic interiors.

Care Instructions
• Wipe with a soft dry or slightly damp cloth
• Avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaners
• Keep away from excessive moisture and direct heat
